caseData.headline: Likely: invoices are fake, inflated or altered

findings.plain: invoices are fake, inflated or altered
the borrower has debt it has not disclosed

signals.explanation: 54 invoice numbers were submitted more than once with different amounts (up to 24.0x the original)
Reported receivables are 14.6x their usual size relative to revenue (2 quarters in a row): money is booked that isn't being collected
4 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model)
Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported
86 invoices are over 5x what the named customer normally pays
'Redwood Specialty Finance LP' holds a lien on the borrower ('Crescent Funding LLC': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed (filed before onboarding: may be a stale filing)
14.7% of invoices past due were never paid by the named customer (85 of 579)
Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible

Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0077)

  - 14.7% of invoices past due were never paid by the named customer (85 of 579) [ref S4-B0077-UNPAID_BY_DEBTOR-c646c40e]
  - Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible [ref S7-B0077-RECEIVABLES_QUALITY-c41ecd86]

Please provide confirmation of whether you owe the listed invoice amounts, and the amounts you have on record by 2026-09-16.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
